accordionMode.description: Whether one or many sections can be open

expandedIndex.description: Section open on load (-1 = all collapsed)

panels.description: The panel groups this container pages through (group defs with children)

defaultValue.description: Initial open index (overrides expandedIndex; -1 = all collapsed)

method.description: Transport method (meshsocket, mqtt, http, local, player)

mode.description: Send mode (broadcast = fire and forget, request = await a reply; only route_msg replies) — meshsocket only

event.description: MeshSocket frame type, sent verbatim — must be a relay verb (broadcast_request, route_msg, route_msg_noreply); the command name goes in payload.msg_type

payload.description: Data to send (supports {{value}} substitution); for broadcast_request include msg_type so servers can demux

source.description: Named entry in the layout's sources (mqtt/http/local)

retain.description: Publish with the MQTT retained flag

httpMethod.description: HTTP verb (default POST with a payload, GET without)

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for this action

op.description: Local-store operation; set/increment/decrement/toggle write a singleton collection (local)

id.description: Record id for update/upsert/delete/select; tokens such as {{selected}} allowed (local)

set.description: Declared field → value for insert/update/upsert and the singleton set op; supports {{value}} and the store tokens (local)

field.description: Singleton field an increment/decrement (number or integer) or toggle (bool) changes (local)

by.description: Step for increment/decrement; any non-zero number or an exact token such as {{value}}; decrement subtracts it; integer fields take whole steps only (local)

verb.description: Player command when method is player: play, pause, toggle, stop, next, previous, seek, skip, like, dislike, shuffle, repeat (see [[audio]])

value.description: The player command's amount: seconds for seek, plus or minus seconds for skip; a number or a token such as {{value}} (player)

confirm.description: dialog = ask in the app's confirmation dialog before sending; Cancel, or 60 s without an answer, sends nothing (the control's own confirm true is the Undo pill)

confirmTitle.description: Confirmation dialog headline (default the control's label; up to 80 characters)

confirmMessage.description: Confirmation dialog body text (up to 600 characters)

confirmLabel.description: Confirm button text (default Confirm; up to 24 characters)

destructive.description: Red confirm button in the confirmation dialog

expand.description: Expand the group with this id (see group-def Expand). No method needed

collapse.description: Close the expanded view of the group with this id

toggleExpand.description: Expand the group with this id, or collapse it when already expanded

tint.description: Icon color (unset = the theme's text color)

activeTint.description: Icon color while playing to an AirPlay device (unset = the theme's accent color)

colorScheme.description: Pins the whole app to dark or light, or follows the device

showHeader.description: Show or hide the header bar

backgroundAnimation.description: Animated page background: {style, colors, speed, intensity}

hub.description: Required. The hub's target_name: it serves the audio and receives commands

mode.description: listen: this phone plays the audio. remote: the hub plays on its own speakers and this phone only controls it

quality.description: Rule per network: { local, wifi, cellular }, each best | lossless | lossy or an ordered list of rendition ids. Low Data Mode counts as cellular

commands.description: hub (every command the hub lists in capabilities) or an object of slots: play, pause, toggle, next, previous, seek, skipForward, skipBackward, like, dislike, shuffle, repeat

nowPlaying.description: { title, subtitle } templates over the current item's fields, e.g. {{title}}, {{artist}}

normalize.description: Apply each item's gain (dB) so tracks play at the same loudness

type.description: Catalog type to register for, e.g. location.visits, sensors.motion, audio.playback (see the catalog below)

send.description: Where readings go: { hub: the hub's target_name, event: the msg_type }

store.description: Local-store collection to write each reading into (alone or with send)

interval.description: Seconds between readings, for sensor types (low power and heat can slow it)

keepAlive.description: Connect+: keep audio.playback or a sensor registration running after the layout is closed

places.description: For location.places: [{ name, latitude, longitude, radius }]; 20 regions app-wide

boxWidth.description: Box width as a fraction of the category slot

scrub.description: Drag sweeps the selection across categories with haptic ticks (readout only — the action still fires on tap)

showYAxis.description: Value labels down the left gutter

whiskers.description: 'tukey' (1.5 × IQR fences + outlier dots) or 'minmax' (full range)

style.description: Visual style variant ("outline" and "outlined" are both accepted)

repeatOnHold.description: Keep firing the action while held, using the system repeat behavior (ignored when longPressAction/longPressGroup is set)

valueMap.description: Synced value → button text ("default" catches the rest)

iconMap.description: Synced value → SF Symbol name (swaps with the native replace effect)

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

scan.description: What the live scanner detects: any of barcode, text

symbologies.description: Barcode filter (qr, ean13, code128, …). Omit for all supported

sendMode.description: auto sends every stabilized detection; tap sends only items the user taps

debounce.description: Seconds before the same decoded value can fire again

torch.description: Show a torch toggle while scanning

snapshot.description: Show a shutter button (implied when snapshotAction is set)

snapshotAction.description: Action fired on the shutter with {{image}}, {{width}}, {{height}}; falls back to action when omitted

haptic.description: Haptic played when a code or text is sent

icon.description: SF Symbol on the Tap to Start card

snapshotQuality.description: JPEG quality 0–1 (auto-lowered to fit the mesh frame budget)

hideLabel.description: Hide the header label (the LIVE chip moves into the viewfinder)

controlHeight.description: Rendered height in points (required in flow-mode grids)

editable.description: Long-press lifts a card; drags emit place/layout and round-trip the synced value

showGrid.description: Faint dot lattice on the surface (uses the snap increment when set)

snap.description: Normalized snap increment applied on drop (0.05 = a 20×20 lattice; 0 = free)

maxZoom.description: Max pinch-zoom scale (1 disables zoom and panning)

items.description: The hosted controls with their normalized frames (see Config)

events.description: pickup / place / layout actions fired as cards are lifted and dropped

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown in the search field while it is empty (default: Search).

carouselPeek.description: Paged mode neighbour peek, as a fraction of the width

panels.description: The panel groups this container pages through (group defs with children)

defaultType.description: Drawing type for every series that sets no type of its own

horizontal.description: Horizontal bars — categories run down the leading edge

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind bars, lines and points in their own colours, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

lineCap.description: End shape of the lines. Cross-control, same on every control

scrub.description: Drag shows a dashed crosshair + live readout (with a selection tick)

showValues.description: Numeric value above each bar / on each vertex

showXAxis.description: Category/x labels along the bottom (leading edge when horizontal)

showYAxis.description: Value labels down the left gutter

smooth.description: Catmull-Rom curve smoothing for line/area series

stacked.description: Stack bar/area series instead of grouping/overlaying

yMax.description: Pin the value axis (bars baseline at 0 by default)

yMin.description: Pin the value axis (bars baseline at 0 by default)

name.description: Legend name and append routing key

type.description: Series drawing type, matched by a switch in CARChart (anything else draws as bar); mix bar, line, area and scatter freely

values.description: Y values at implicit x = 0, 1, 2 (aligned with categories); null is a gap. Histogram - raw samples to bin; waterfall - signed deltas

points.description: Explicit [x, y] pairs for scatter or unevenly sampled series

totals.description: Waterfall only: indices drawn as running totals from zero

config.description: ChatConfig: target, showTypingIndicators, showReadReceipts, allowReactions, allowReplies, allowImages, historyCount, tint

allowClear.description: Show the local \"Clear Chat\" affordance in the header (default true). Server-driven clears are always honored regardless.

allowImages.description: No effect yet: the app has no image attachments.

systemMessageEvents.description: No effect yet: the app does not read it.

tint.description: Color of your bubbles and highlights; unset they follow the theme accent.

pad.description: Degrees of breathing room between arcs

scrub.description: Drag around the ring sweeps the spotlight arc-to-arc like a dial, with haptic ticks (the action still fires on tap)

icon.description: SF Symbol shown beside the label, tinted with tint

hideLabel.description: Hide the label above the swatch

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

controlHeight.description: Rendered height in points (required in flow-mode grids)

tolerance.description: Half-angle (°) within which the needle counts as pointing at a puck

dwell.description: Seconds to hold on a puck before its action fires (0 = instant)

tint.description: Needle and accent color (default the theme accent); pucks keep their own tint

cardinalColor.description: E/S/W cardinal color (default the theme's faint tertiary grey; all four letters share it, N included)

editable.description: Allow dragging pucks to re-bearing them

type.description: Control type (required); decides which per-type fields apply

id.description: Unique identifier among the layout's controls and groups (required); used for value storage, sync targeting and visibility references

landscape.description: Placement when an iPhone is on its side: {position, span} or {hidden: true}

regular.description: Placement on an iPad-width page: {position, span} or {hidden: true}

name.description: Readable name the editor shows; never used for identity or on the wire

action.description: Command fired on interaction (an ActionDefinition, see actions)

longPressGroup.description: Sub-group popup shown on long-press (a GroupDefinition, see long-press)

snapshotAction.description: Camera only: action fired on shutter with {{image}} substitution

sync.description: Live state listeners (SyncDefinition list, see sync)

enabled.description: Enable/disable condition (a VisibilityCondition); false dims the control and ignores touches

role.description: On a button inside a form group: submit makes pressing it submit the form

field.description: Inside a form group: the draft field this input writes (default the id)

theme.description: Per-control theme overrides; same keys as the layout theme block plus per-type keys (see theming)

colors.description: Colour slots set to a role, a theme colour or a colour, or an ordered list for the series slot (see theming Colour roles)

unsupportedType.description: Written by the app when it replaces a control type it does not know; never authored

carouselStyle.description: Carousel panel chrome (default glass; translucent and liquidGlass use the material-glass look)

carouselPeek.description: Carousel paged mode - neighbour peek as a fraction of the container width, clamped 0 to 0.3

sortboardConfig.description: Config object for the matching control type; its keys are the sortboardConfig group fields in that control's doc

compassConfig.description: Config object for the matching control type; its keys are the compassConfig group fields in that control's doc

pinboardConfig.description: Config object for the matching control type; its keys are the pinboardConfig group fields in that control's doc

canvasConfig.description: Config object for the matching control type; its keys are the canvasConfig group fields in that control's doc

symbolConfig.description: Config object for the matching control type; its keys are the symbolConfig group fields in that control's doc

statTileConfig.description: Config object for the matching control type; its keys are the statTileConfig group fields in that control's doc

hideBackground.description: Remove the glass card behind the control. The on/off switch in the Background chip (inverted)

backgroundColor.description: Card fill colour, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Absent = the theme surface. Edit hint background = the pose's Background chip (on/off, colour, opacity, glass or solid)

backgroundOpacity.description: Card fill opacity, 0-1; multiplies any alpha in backgroundColor. Absent = 1

backgroundMaterial.description: glass lays a translucent material under the fill; solid is a flat fill. Absent = the theme surface

backgroundPadding.description: Space between the card edge and the control, in points. Absent = the theme's controlPadding (8)

backgroundCornerRadius.description: Card corner radius in points. Absent = the theme's cornerRadius (12)

backgroundBorderWidth.description: Card border width in points; 0 removes the border. Absent = the theme's borderWidth (1)

backgroundBorderColor.description: Card border colour, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Absent = the theme border

backgroundShadow.description: Elevation, the blur radius of a soft drop shadow under the card, in points. 0 = none

backgroundShadowOpacity.description: Opacity of the card drop shadow, 0-1. Needs backgroundShadow above 0; off when hideBackground is true

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

control.description: Argument: {control: id} reads whatever that control currently displays

derive.description: Argument: {derive: id} reads another derive entry's result

clock.description: Argument: {clock: true} is now, as epoch seconds

add.description: Sum of the arguments; sum is an alias

sub.description: First argument minus each of the rest

div.description: First argument divided by each of the rest (nil on a zero divisor)

coalesce.description: The first argument that is not nil (its value as-is, number or text)

round.description: {of, places}: round to places decimals (0-12, default 0); a bare argument rounds to a whole number

clamp.description: {of, min, max}: keep the value inside min..max (either bound may be omitted, not both)

scale.description: {of, from: [a, b], to: [c, d]}: linear map of a..b onto c..d (not clamped)

band.description: {of, stops, labels}: number to a label; labels[i] for the first stop the value is below, else the last label

since.description: {of, unit}: time elapsed since a date (epoch seconds or ISO-8601), in seconds/minutes/hours/days/weeks

until.description: {of, unit}: time remaining until a date, negative once it has passed

of.description: Argument of round, clamp, scale, band, since and until: a number, or an argument object (control, derive, clock, or another op)

stops.description: band: ascending thresholds; the value is bucketed against them

labels.description: band: one label per bucket (stops count + 1)

unit.description: since / until: unit of the result (default seconds)

label.description: Optional section label centered on the divider

tint.description: Line color (unset = the text color at 20%)

schemaVersion.description: Grammar version of the document (optional; absent = 1). Bumped only when an older app would misread the file

version.description: The author's revision label (the Layout Hub's "Revision"); never gates anything

format.description: Always the string carter; written on export only, never required

extensions.description: Reverse-DNS keyed tool data, top level and per control/group; preserved, never interpreted, 64 KB cap

provenance.description: Where this document came from (immediate parents, package)

requires.description: What the document needs from the app; features are name@N strings

flipTrigger.description: Gesture that advances to the next face

panels.description: The panel groups this container pages through (group defs with children)

mode.description: edit prefills the draft from the collection's selected record ({{selected}}) and refills it when the selection moves

collection.description: Local collection the form edits; the prefill source in edit mode and the default collection of a local submit

fields.description: Field name → validators, a closed set: required, min, max, minLength, maxLength, oneOf, kind (integer|number|date|email|url). No regex

submit.description: The one action the form writes with (local, http, mqtt or meshsocket); {{form}} is the whole draft, {{form.<field>}} one field

afterSubmit.description: After a submit, clear the draft back to its starting values, or keep what was submitted

editable.description: Drag along a bar to set its progress

scrub.description: When not editable: drag sweeps the row selection with haptic ticks (the action still fires on tap)

showGrid.description: Vertical gridlines at the axis ticks

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the value arc in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

lineCap.description: End shape of the track, value arc and segment arcs (the blended gradient arc keeps its butt ends until set). Cross-control, same on every control

colorBlend.description: How much the segment colors blend, 0–1. 0 = hard boundaries, 1 = one smooth gradient, between = feathered edges. Needs segments.

tint.description: Primary arc fill color (when no segments)

step.description: Determines decimal formatting of center value

arcRotation.description: Rotates the arc start position in degrees

arcThickness.description: Arc stroke width in points. Omit to auto-scale with the gauge's size.

hideValue.description: Show just the arc — hide the center value

forecast.description: Look ahead beside the real reading: countdown = the value is a time and the widget counts down to it; reach = the value is expected to arrive at forecastTarget (at the time forecastTimeFrom holds) or to keep moving by forecastRate per second. A newer real value always replaces the guess; past its end the value reads stale.

forecastTarget.description: The value this one is expected to arrive at (with forecast "reach")

forecastTimeFrom.description: Id of the control whose value is the arrival time (epoch seconds or ISO-8601), for forecast "reach

forecastRate.description: Keep moving by this much per second from the last real reading (forecast "reach", no time needed)

unit.description: Measurement unit the value arrives in ([[values#Units]] name or symbol, e.g. celsius, km/h). The readout converts to the device locale (°C → °F in the US); min, max and segments stay in this unit, so the arc is the same everywhere. Unknown strings show literally.

enabled.description: false suppresses every surface, including the auto-derived glance (default true)

icon.description: SF Symbol glyph for the layout (island leading slot, widget header)

tint.description: Hex accent for the surfaces (defaults to accentColor)

hero.description: Control id of the one value that represents the layout on the smallest surfaces

slots.description: Up to 3 control ids for secondary readouts

liveActivity.description: Start a Live Activity (Dynamic Island + lock screen) while the layout is connected (default false)

controls.description: Control Center / lock-screen / Action-button controls (toggle, button, cycle, step, set)

live.description: How live each surface is — tier plus per-surface cadences, stale windows and refresh paths

widgets.description: Home/lock-screen widgets defined as tile scenes

island.description: Dynamic Island regions defined as tiles (compact, minimal, expanded)

lockScreen.description: Lock-screen Live Activity banner scene (defaults to island.expanded.bottom)

warmOpen.description: Open the layout filled with its last-known values and sparkline trends from the glance snapshot (under 24 h old), shown as stale until a live frame arrives; a seeded toggle does not send until then. false opens on defaults (default true)

endSummary.description: Keep an ended card. After the session ends the Live Activity lingers for a few minutes showing the last values and when it ended, then dismisses. false ends it at once (default true)

id.description: Stable id within the layout (the registry key is <layoutId>#<id>)

label.description: Name in the controls gallery and on the control

kind.description: toggle and button are the two templates iOS offers. cycle, step and set are buttons whose press computes a value

control.description: Layout control this one mirrors and drives. Required for cycle, step and set; optional for toggle and button. Its live value is what the control shows, and its own action (with {{value}} substituted) is what a press sends

event.description: Explicit MeshSocket event instead of the bound control's action

payload.description: Static payload for event; value-bearing kinds merge {value: <value>} into it

on.description: Toggle styling while on, { label, icon, tint }

off.description: Toggle styling while off, { label, icon, tint }

valueControl.description: Show THIS control's formatted value as the value label (for example a lux reading beside a lights toggle)

valueLabel.description: Template over the value label; {{value}} is the bound or valueControl display value, for example "{{value}} lx

states.description: cycle ring in press order, each { value, label, icon, tint }; a press sends the next state and the control shows the current one

delta.description: step increment, added to the control's current value (negative to decrement), clamped to its min and max

value.description: set target value, the value sent on press

presets.description: Preset values for a step or set control (25, 50, 75, 100); one button each in buttons mode

surface.description: How the control reaches widgets, the Live Activity and Control Center. buttons is a row of press buttons, cycle one button that walks the options, big a tap that opens the app on a full-screen one-control sheet. Absent uses the kind's default

liveActivity.description: Glance field. Start a Live Activity while the layout is connected (default false; the island is prime space, so it is opt-in). live.activity.start can start it instead

compactLeading.description: island field. One tile for the left of the compact island (default the layout icon, which bounces on update)

compactTrailing.description: island field. One tile for the right of the compact island (default the hero value, ring or dot)

minimal.description: island field. One tile for the minimal island, shown when another app's activity shares it (default a freshness ring around the connection dot)

expanded.description: island field. The four expanded regions leading, trailing, center and bottom, each a tile or a scene

keyline.description: island field. The island outline colour, drawn by iOS only on a full-black background. accent (default), a hex like #FF9F0A, or none

live.tier.description: Preset for how live every surface is; explicit fields below override it

live.activity.cadence.description: Seconds between updates while the app is open (floor 1)

live.activity.remoteCadence.description: Seconds between updates pushed by the relay (floor 2)

live.activity.stale.description: Seconds until the surface marks its data stale (default 120, floor 30)

live.activity.priority.description: Push priority; immediate is budgeted by iOS

live.activity.start.description: onConnect starts it when the layout connects; remote lets only a hub start it by push-to-start; never keeps it off

live.widgets.pullEvery.description: Seconds between widget pulls in pull mode (floor 300)

live.widgets.stale.description: Seconds until a widget calls its data stale (floor 30)

live.background.silentPush.description: Also wake the app with a silent push on relay updates; heavily throttled by iOS, off by default

lockScreen.description: Glance field. The lock-screen Live Activity banner, a scene (rows of tiles). Defaults to island.expanded.bottom. A bare tile is accepted and becomes one row

columns.description: Scene field. Columns the banner lays out against; defaults to the widest row, capped at 12

rows.description: Scene field. Rows of tiles; each row is an array of tile objects (see [[glance]])

id.description: Stable id within the layout; the widget gallery offers "<title> · <layout>" per id. An entry with no id cannot be offered

icon.description: SF Symbol glyph shown in the gallery

families.description: Any of systemSmall systemMedium systemLarge systemExtraLarge accessoryCircular accessoryRectangular accessoryInline. Absent or empty means every family

scene.description: The base scene (rows of tiles), re-flowed per family unless that family has an override

columns.description: Scene field. Columns the scene lays out against; defaults to the widest row, capped at 12

rows.description: Scene field. Rows of tiles; each row is an array of tile objects (see [[glance]] for the tile table)

systemSmall.description: Optional scene override for that family, same shape as scene. The same applies to systemMedium, systemLarge, systemExtraLarge, accessoryCircular, accessoryRectangular and accessoryInline

attractionForce.description: How strongly connected nodes pull together

centerForce.description: How strongly nodes are pulled toward center

contentEvent.description: Dead. Reserved for a content-push model; nothing reads it

damping.description: Velocity dampening per tick (0-1, lower = more friction)

edgeCurved.description: Use curved (quadratic) edges instead of straight

labelOffset.description: Distance from node center to label

nodeHighlightColor.description: Dead. Nothing reads it; a selected node is not recoloured

particleColor.description: Color of the particles running along the edges (falls back to the edge colour)

particleSpeed.description: Speed multiplier of the edge particles (1 = normal)

velocityDecay.description: Velocity decay rate (0-1, lower = faster settling)

columns.description: Number of columns the grid is divided into (required)

rows.description: Number of rows the grid is divided into (required)

rowHeight.description: Points per row-unit in 2-D mode (default 56). The word \"auto\" sizes each row to its content instead (a list itemTemplate grid: compact rows)

spacing.description: Points between neighbouring cells, across and down (default 8, the theme's grid gap). Shrinks and grows with the grid's scale

scale.description: Size the grid's controls draw at: a number from 0.3 to 1.5 or \"auto\" (from the group's shape: the smaller of span rows / grid rows and span columns / grid columns, at most 1; rowHeight / 56 when a rowHeight is set); default 1. See group-def Scale

reflow.description: Landscape policy for a tab's grid: 'auto' (default; columns double and children re-pack) or 'stretch' (keep the portrait cells, wider)

id.description: Unique identifier among the layout's controls and groups (required)

name.description: Readable name the editor shows for this group; never used for identity

label.description: Header text shown above the group; absent or null for no header

position.description: Zero-indexed [row, col] grid cell within the parent (required)

landscape.description: This group's cell when an iPhone is on its side: {position, span} or {hidden: true}

regular.description: This group's cell on an iPad-width page: {position, span} or {hidden: true}

grid.description: Internal grid for the group's children (a grid-dimensions object; required)

columns.description: Columns of the group's inner grid (grid.columns; the editor offers 1 to 12, as for a tab)

spacing.description: Points between the group's cells, across and down (grid.spacing; default 8, the theme's grid gap)

rows.description: Rows of the group's inner grid (grid.rows)

rowHeight.description: Points per row of the group's inner grid (grid.rowHeight; default 56)

scale.description: Size the group's controls draw at (grid.scale): a number from 0.3 to 1.5, or \"auto\" (from the group's shape: the smaller of span rows / grid rows and span columns / grid columns, at most 1; rowHeight / 56 when the grid sets a rowHeight); default 1. See Scale

dynamic.description: Event name whose broadcasts replace the children at runtime (see Dynamic Groups)

visible.description: Show/hide based on another control's value (a VisibilityCondition)

enabled.description: Enable/disable every child; false dims the group and ignores touches

form.description: Make the group a form whose inputs write a draft, written once by submit

hideBackground.description: Remove the glass card behind the group

pulse.description: Flash a ring around the group when a live event lands

theme.description: Theme overrides for the group's header, card and every child (same keys as a control's theme)

expand.description: Let the group grow into a foreground container with a corner close (X): {trigger: tap|hold|both, style: fullScreen|sheet, grid, children, title}. children are {ref, position, span} placements that move the group's own children, or controls that exist only when expanded. See Expand

trigger.description: What opens the expanded group (expand.trigger): tap, hold, both, none, a control id, or an array like [\"hold\", \"more-button\"]

style.description: Where the expanded group lands (expand.style): the whole screen, or a large sheet over a dimmed page

title.description: Heading shown on the expanded group (expand.title); empty uses the group's own title

action.description: Fired by a tap on the group that no child claims (static text, images, gauges without an action, the card background and padding). Same shape as a control's action. A child's own taps and holds win. Ignored when `expand` also opens on tap

extensions.description: Tool data keyed by reverse-DNS name; preserved, never interpreted

calendar.description: Activity calendar: lay a day-keyed payload out as 7 weekday rows x week columns, zero-filled, month labels; tap a day to read it

weekStartsOn.description: Calendar week start (default: the bound local source's weekStartsOn, else monday)

weeks.description: Calendar shows only the most recent N weeks (default the whole span, up to 106)

cellCorner.description: Older name of cellCornerRadius; cellCornerRadius wins when both are set

cellShape.description: square or circle (circle reads as dot-matrix/LED)

colors.description: Continuous: 2+ gradient stops. Discrete: the palette (value = index)

discrete.description: Treat values as palette indices instead of a continuous range

drag.description: Drag paints the first-touched cell's new value across cells

editable.description: Tap cycles a cell (discrete: next palette index; continuous: 0 ↔ vMax toggle)

sendMode.description: cell fires per change; matrix fires the whole dataset once an edit burst settles (~0.4s)

showColLabels.description: Column labels along the top (when cols present; auto-thinned)

showRowLabels.description: Row labels down the leading edge (when rows present)

showScale.description: Gradient scale legend under the grid (continuous only)

showValues.description: Numeric value inside each cell (when cells are large enough)

progress.description: hubSurfaces key. The hub's progress tasks: the pill, the tray and the progress sheet. false refuses progress frames with reason off

toast.description: hubSurfaces key. The hub's toasts under the status bar. false refuses toast frames with reason off

haptic.description: hubSurfaces key. Which of the hub's haptics play: all (true), light (light, selection and success only) or off (false). A refused haptic answers reason off

island.description: hubSurfaces key. The hub's progress tasks also on the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen. false keeps them in the app; the app-wide Live Activities switch still gates it

log.description: hubSurfaces key. The hub's log streams and the console sheet. false refuses log frames with reason off

url.description: Static remote image URL (an asset:// address is reserved, not loaded yet)

imageShadow.description: Soft shadow blur under the image (0 = none)

aspectRatio.description: fit (scale to fit) or fill (scale to fill, may crop)

iconMap.description: Incoming value → SF Symbol name ("default" catches the rest)

colorMap.description: Incoming value → hex tint for the mapped symbol

overview.description: What CAR-TER is and how it works

sticky.description: Stick stays where released instead of snapping to center

sendRate.description: Throttle interval in seconds for action firing

rows.description: Row whitelist and order: [{ key, label, format, icon, unit }]

keyValueStyle.description: rows = label left / value right; chips = wrapping pills; grid = cards

columns.description: How many columns of rows or cards to lay out (grid defaults to 2)

sortKeys.description: Sort keys alphabetically instead of keeping the feed's own order

hideEmpty.description: Skip rows whose value is null or an empty string

maxRows.description: Cap on rendered rows (0 = all of them)

format.description: Default number format for rows without their own (percent, duration, bytes, suffix:°C, …)

colorMap.description: Value → hex tint, so a value can carry its own status color

tint.description: Value color when no colorMap entry matches

keyTint.description: Color of the key names (default: the theme's secondary color)

valueTint.description: Color of the values when no colorMap entry matches (default: tint)

subtitle.description: A quieter second line under the text (caption size, secondary color). In a list itemTemplate it takes {{item.<field>}}

lines.description: Most lines the text may take (1 = truncate, N = wrap up to N, 0 = wrap freely). Also limits the subtitle

style.description: Text style variant (terminal = ANSI terminal renderer)

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the text in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

fontWeight.description: Font weight laid over the text style

forecast.description: Look ahead beside the real reading: countdown = the value is a time and the widget counts down to it; reach = the value is expected to arrive at forecastTarget (at the time forecastTimeFrom holds) or to keep moving by forecastRate per second. A newer real value always replaces the guess; past its end the value reads stale.

forecastTarget.description: The value this one is expected to arrive at (with forecast "reach")

forecastTimeFrom.description: Id of the control whose value is the arrival time (epoch seconds or ISO-8601), for forecast "reach

forecastRate.description: Keep moving by this much per second from the last real reading (forecast "reach", no time needed)

unit.description: Measurement unit the value arrives in ([[values#Units]] name or symbol, e.g. celsius, km/h). A numeric value converts to the device locale; text values show as sent. Unknown strings show literally.

scrollable.description: Fixed-height scrolling terminal/log view that keeps the latest line in view (pair with controlHeight)

formatValue.description: Value display format (see formatValue table; relative / relative:day show a date as time-since)

placeholder.description: Shown by a relative-date label with no date yet (default "Never")

valueMap.description: Incoming value → display text ("default" catches the rest)

cornerRadius.description: Control corner radius (card behind the text, when a background is set)

version.description: The author's revision label (required; never gates anything — see document-contract)

schemaVersion.description: Grammar version, optional (absent = 1); set by writers, bumped only when an older app would misread the file

extensions.description: Reverse-DNS keyed tool data the app preserves and never interprets (64 KB cap; see document-contract)

requires.description: The app version and features this layout needs, e.g. {'app': '1.3', 'features': ['control.symbol']}; a soft gate, so an older app still renders what it can and shows one update banner (see Requires and fallback)

headerTitle.description: Title shown in the header bar

accentColor.description: Hex accent for the layout's library card, switcher and glance fallback (e.g. "#5AC8FA"); controls use theme.accentColor (see theming#Cascade)

appearance.description: App shell appearance (color scheme, header, background image)

theme.description: Visual theme (colors, fonts, spacing, palette tokens)

sources.description: Named external data sources (MQTT brokers, HTTP APIs)

secrets.description: Credentials the layout's {{secret:name}} placeholders use: name, label, kind, hosts, mesh, allowInsecureHTTP. Names only; the values live in the phone's Keychain (see Secrets)

derive.description: Values computed on the phone from other values, keyed by id, e.g. {'watts': {'mul': [{'control': 'volts'}, {'control': 'amps'}]}} (see derive)

keepAwake.description: Ask to suppress the iOS auto screen lock while this layout is open (a request the user can veto)

liveness.description: Layout-wide staleness default for sync bindings, e.g. {'staleAfter': 120} (opt-in; HTTP polls use max(this, 3x interval); see sync)

batchPublishers.description: Send the publishers as one sensor_batch frame per tick of the fastest interval instead of one frame per reading (see publishers)

glance.description: Widgets, Dynamic Island, lock screen and Control Center surfaces projected from this layout (see glance)

id.description: Stable layout identifier (see Identity); default scope for a local store namespace

alerts.description: Alert rules the app evaluates on incoming events (id, event, valuePath, ...)

state.description: State sync config: lets the layout's own control values sync through a mesh

publishers.description: Sensor publishers: device sensors streamed out as readings (see publishers)

sensorSetup.description: Which device sensors and permissions the layout asks the user to set up (see sensors)

background.description: Background event registrations the layout asks for (see background); replaces sensorSetup, which still works and is read as the same thing

audio.description: Hub audio: at most one per layout, only hub required (see audio); the hub streams its music to this phone and iOS shows it in Now Playing

sampleValues.description: Control id to placeholder value: display only. Shown by Try and previews, and on the live page by a control with no value of its own until its first real one; never sent, saved or published. Applies without a tap unless a sample holds a link (see Sample values)

hubSurfaces.description: What the layout's hub may draw in the app: false for nothing, or an object of the [[hub-surfaces]] keys (progress, toast, haptic, island, log), each default on; absent = all on. The person's own off wins (see docs/HUB-SURFACES.md)

url.description: WebSocket URL of the mesh server

token.description: Auth token; prefer a {{secret:name}} placeholder, never a literal secret

mode.description: pair connects to one peer; room joins a shared room

formatValue.description: Default date format for columns with no `format` of their own: relative:day (4 days ago), relative, date, date:time. Applies to date text and epoch numbers; other text shows as is.

listColumns.description: Column definitions: [{key, label, format}]. Absent or empty: a store-bound list shows its collection's first fields, any other list its rows' own keys.

emptyText.description: Line shown when the list has no rows. Default: \"No <label> yet\".

defaultValue.description: Seed rows shown before the first sync (the same row objects a sync delivers)

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

paging.description: Rows fed by the hub a page at a time: {pageSize, request, replyType, replyPath, window, queryFrom}. Absent: the list shows the rows its sync delivers. See [[#Paging]].

pageSize.description: Rows asked for per request, sent as {{limit}} (5-200). A hub may send fewer.

request.description: The action sent for each page (meshsocket; `method` may be left out), with {{cursor}}, {{offset}}, {{limit}}, {{query}} and {{req}} filled into its payload. See [[#Paging]].

replyType.description: msg_type of the hub's page broadcasts. A page is {items (or rows), cursor?, total?, more?, offset?, query?, req?}; a frame of this type without items or rows is ignored.

replyPath.description: Dot path from the reply frame to the page object, e.g. result for {msg_type, req, result: {rows, total}}. Absent: the frame is the page.

window.description: Most rows kept on the phone at once (at least 4 pages, at most 5000). Rows far from the screen are let go and asked for again when you scroll back.

queryFrom.description: Id of a text input whose text is the search, sent as {{query}}. A change starts the list over after 250 ms without typing.

itemTemplate.description: A group definition ({grid, children}) drawn once per row; {{item.<field>}} in its children's text, values, images and payloads is replaced from that row. Absent: rows are columns. See [[#Item templates]].

itemSpacing.description: Points between rows (0-64, default 2), and between the cards of a card grid (itemLayout: grid).

itemStyle.description: plain: rows sit inside the list's card. card: each itemTemplate row draws its template group's own card (fill, corners, theme), so rows read as separate cards; pair it with hideBackground: true and an itemSpacing. See [[#Card rows]].

itemLayout.description: rows: one templated row per line. grid: the itemTemplate rows as cards side by side, as many columns as keep each card 150 pt wide or more, at most 3 (2 on a phone-wide list, 3 on an iPad or in landscape, 1 on a list too narrow for two), itemSpacing apart; paging, search, row taps and itemStyle work as in rows. Needs an itemTemplate: column rows stay one per line. Any other value is rows. See [[#Card grid]].

type.description: Must be "local" — declared inside the layout's sources block

namespace.description: Scope for every non-shared collection (default the layout id, else its name); must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$ and cannot be "shared

collections.description: Collection name → { fields, shared?, mirror?, singleton?, defaults?, order? }; fields maps a name to one of string number integer bool date json, or to { type, label?, unit?, required?, default?, choices?, multiple?, range?, decimals?, labels?, symbol?, display? }

views.description: View name → { from, where?, orderBy?, limit? }; a named row set over a collection or another view

weekStartsOn.description: First day of the week for the week bucket and the startOfWeek token

label.description: Friendly collection name shown in the type builder

fields.description: Field name to type (string number integer bool date json) or {type, ...options}

shared.description: Put the collection in the device-wide shared namespace

mirror.description: Reserved for the studio change-notice; stored, not read by the store

singleton.description: The collection holds exactly one row, id singleton

defaults.description: Starting values for the singleton row (needs singleton: true)

from.description: The collection or view this view reads

controlHeight.description: Console area height in points (default: compact, capped at 200). Set it when the console should fill a tall grid span.

tint.description: Color of the lines with no level

defaultValue.description: Seed lines shown before the first sync (strings, or objects with text and level)

longPressAction.description: Action fired on long press (no popup)

mapStyle.description: Map rendering style (globe frames the whole Earth)

tint.description: Default marker color (used when a marker carries none)

mapConfig.description: Property→style mapping for GeoJSON feeds (marker size/color/label/ripple)

recenter.description: How the camera reacts to new data (mapConfig.recenter)

markerSizeProperty.description: Numeric feed property that drives pin size (mapConfig.markerSizeProperty), scaled from markerSizeDomain into markerSizeRange

markerSizeRange.description: Output pin diameter range [smallest, largest] in points (mapConfig.markerSizeRange)

markerColorProperty.description: Feed property holding a hex color for each pin (mapConfig.markerColorProperty)

markerLabelProperty.description: Feed property used as each pin's label (mapConfig.markerLabelProperty)

rippleProperty.description: Numeric feed property that decides which pins ripple (mapConfig.rippleProperty)

rippleThreshold.description: rippleProperty >= rippleThreshold makes that pin ripple (mapConfig.rippleThreshold)

ripple.description: Ring styling for rippling pins: color, period (s, default 1.6), radius (pt, default 44) (mapConfig.ripple)

maxMarkers.description: Cap on drawn pins; a public feed can be unbounded (mapConfig.maxMarkers)

center.description: Fixed camera centre [lat, lng] instead of fitting the data; combines with recenter (mapConfig.center)

markersPath.description: Dot-path to the array of point objects in a non-GeoJSON payload, e.g. "ac" (mapConfig.markersPath)

markerLatProperty.description: Property holding latitude on each point object, e.g. "lat"; switches to object-array mode (mapConfig.markerLatProperty)

markerLngProperty.description: Property holding longitude on each point object, e.g. "lon" (mapConfig.markerLngProperty)

markerIdProperty.description: Property giving each pin a stable identity across updates; needed for smooth motion (mapConfig.markerIdProperty)

coordinateOrder.description: Order of raw [a, b, weight] number triples, GeoJSON-style lnglat or latlng (mapConfig.coordinateOrder)

minWeight.description: In number-triple mode, drop points whose weight is below this before capping (mapConfig.minWeight)

markerSymbol.description: Default SF Symbol name for the symbol and puck pin styles, e.g. "airplane" (mapConfig.markerSymbol)

markerSymbolProperty.description: Per-object property naming an SF Symbol, overriding markerSymbol (mapConfig.markerSymbolProperty)

motion.description: Glide pins between updates instead of snapping; needs markerIdProperty with more than one pin (mapConfig.motion)

motionDuration.description: Seconds one position glide takes; set near the poll interval (mapConfig.motionDuration)

hideLabel.description: Hide the header label above the map

controlHeight.description: Map height in points in a flow-mode grid (2-D grids size it by rowSpan)

navigate.description: Where a button tap goes after its action fires: tab:<id|title|#index>

optionIcons.description: Optional SF Symbols parallel to options, supported in every picker style

optionLabels.description: Display labels parallel to options; actions and sync use the original option values

placeholder.description: Text shown when no options are available or a picker has no selection

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

pieStyle.description: Classic pie, donut, spin-to-select wheel, or radial menu

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the slices in their own colours, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

centerText.description: Donut center text; {{total}} interpolates the slice sum

sliceGap.description: Even-width gap between neighbouring slices in points (slices narrower than the gap drop it)

sliceCornerRadius.description: Rounds every slice corner (outer and donut inner) in points, clamped for tiny slices

explodeSelected.description: Tapped slice pops outward (**wheels default false)

percent.description: Show values as % of the total

showLabels.description: Slice labels (auto-hidden on thin slices; *menu defaults false — icons lead)

showLegend.description: Wrapping dot-chip legend under the chart

showValues.description: Append each slice's value to its label

spinDuration.description: Approximate seconds a full-strength spin takes to settle

spinTicks.description: Haptic tick per slice boundary while spinning

startAngle.description: Degrees the first slice starts at (0 = 12 o'clock, clockwise)

icon.description: SF Symbol in the wheel/menu hub before a result lands

surfacePrimary.description: Background fill (also the hairline slice gap color)

controlHeight.description: Rendered height in points (required in flow-mode grids)

background.description: SF Symbol drawn faint behind the surface (floor-plan / map backdrop)

searchable.description: Show a filter field above the option area

hidePalette.description: Hide the option area (surfaces whose markers all start placed)

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the ring or bar fill in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

lineCap.description: End shape of the ring (the linear bar rounds its corners for round, squares them for butt and square). Cross-control, same on every control

colorByValue.description: Color zones [{limit, color}] in the min–max unit — the fill takes the zone colour of the current value (gauge semantics). Overrides tint.

arcThickness.description: Ring stroke width, or bar height, in points. Absent scales with the control size.

barCornerRadius.description: Corner rounding of the linear bar (progressStyle bar)

hideValue.description: Show just the arc — hide the center value

A newer real value always replaces the guess; past its end the value reads stale.

forecastTarget.description: The value this one is expected to arrive at (with forecast "reach")

forecastTimeFrom.description: Id of the control whose value is the arrival time (epoch seconds or ISO-8601), for forecast "reach

forecastRate.description: Keep moving by this much per second from the last real reading (forecast "reach", no time needed)

unit.description: Measurement unit the value arrives in ([[values#Units]] name or symbol, e.g. celsius, km/h). With a unit the readout shows the value itself (converted to the device locale) instead of the fill percentage; min and max stay in this unit. Unknown strings show literally.

sensor.description: Pipeline to stream (heading, motion, barometer, device, audio, location)

event.description: Server event that fires the pulse

direction.description: Ring expands outward or contracts inward

text.description: Static content to encode (overridden by sync)

qrBackground.description: Fill behind the code (default: none, the card shows through)

hideLabel.description: Hide the caption below the code

curved.description: Rounded polygon instead of straight edges

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind each series outline in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

lineCap.description: End shape of each series outline: it is a closed shape, so the cap sets its corners (round = round, square = sharp, butt = cut). Cross-control, same on every control

showValues.description: Numeric value beside each vertex (the dragged vertex always shows)

step.description: Snap dragged values to this step (e.g. 1, 5, 0.1)

nodeSpacing.description: Minimum vertical gap between nodes in a column

cellCornerRadius.description: Node corner rounding (default: a third of the node width)

scrub.description: Drag sweeps the spotlight from node to node with haptic ticks (the action still fires on tap)

optionLabels.description: Display labels parallel to options; actions and sync use the original option values

placeholder.description: Text shown when no options are available or a picker has no selection

style.description: System segmented, capsule pills, or tap-a-star rating (options "1"…"N"; sends the number)

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

method.description: Set to "sensor" on a sync entry to bind local hardware

step.description: Detent spacing measured from min; zero or negative allows continuous values

continuous.description: Send actions while dragging; false previews locally and sends once on release

hideValue.description: Hide numeric readouts in every slider style; keep the label and interaction

arcAngle.description: Arc sweep in degrees (radial style only)

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

controlHeight.description: Rendered height in points (required in flow-mode grids — see Sizing)

searchable.description: Show a filter field above the option area

hidePalette.description: Hide the option area (server-seeded boards where items start placed)

columns.description: How many zone columns to lay out

type.description: Kind of source (mqtt or http external, local on-device store)

url.description: MQTT broker address: mqtt://host[:port] or mqtts://host[:port]

baseURL.description: HTTP base URL relative sync/action paths resolve against

password.description: MQTT password; write a {{secret:name}} placeholder, not the literal value

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every poll/request; put credentials in as {{secret:name}}

interval.description: Default poll interval (seconds) for HTTP syncs that omit their own

sparklinePoints.description: Max data points retained in the buffer

lineWidth.description: Line stroke width in points. Omit to scale with the control's height.

sparklineFill.description: Fill the area under the line with a gradient

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the line in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

lineCap.description: End shape of the line. Cross-control, same on every control

colorByValue.description: Color zones [{limit, color}] — the line and fill take the zone colour of the value at each height. Overrides tint.

colorBlend.description: How much the zone colors blend, 0–1. 0 = hard boundaries, 1 = one smooth gradient. Needs colorByValue.

defaultValue.description: Seed series drawn before the first sync (an array of numbers), trimmed to sparklinePoints

unit.description: Measurement unit the value arrives in ([[values#Units]] name or symbol, e.g. milliseconds, celsius). Shown small beside the number and converted to the device locale; thresholds, reference and delta stay in this unit. Unknown strings show literally.

valueSize.description: Point size of the big number

formatValue.description: Number format for the big number (see the formatValue table, e.g. decimal:1)

step.description: Determines decimal formatting of the number when formatValue is unset

sparklinePoints.description: Max values kept in the faint history sparkline

lineWidth.description: Stroke width of the faint trend line, in points

tint.description: Sparkline colour when no thresholds are set

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the history curve in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

lineCap.description: End shape of the history curve. Cross-control, same on every control

hideBackground.description: Remove the card (and its threshold tint)

animation.description: Motion profile for the number roll

reference.description: The value the change is measured against (yesterday, target…)

referencePath.description: Dot path in the same payload as the value to a live reference; overrides reference once it arrives

deltaMode.description: Percent change, or the absolute difference in the value's unit

invertDelta.description: Colour a rise red and a fall green (latency, error rate)

thresholds.description: Background bands [{limit, color}], gauge segment semantics

criticalAbove.description: At or above this value the tile fills solid with its band colour

criticalBelow.description: At or below this value the tile fills solid with its band colour

showSparkline.description: Draw the faint history sparkline under the number

statusColors.description: Map state strings to hex colors: {\"online\": \"#34C759\", \"offline\": \"#FF3B30\"}

style.description: dot (circle) or badge (pill with state text)

glow.description: Halo strength behind the light, 0 (none) to 1 (full). The badge style tints its pill by the same amount.

step.description: Positive increment/decrement amount; zero or negative falls back to 1

repeatOnHold.description: Hold plus or minus to repeat steps using the system repeat behavior

wraps.description: Step past an endpoint to cycle to the opposite endpoint

hideValue.description: Hide the numeric readout; keep the buttons, label, and spoken value

formatValue.description: Value format: decimal, percent, time, duration, bytes, bytesKB, bps, relative or none; decimal:N, prefix:X and suffix:X also work in JSON

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

systemName.description: SF Symbol name (the glyph at rest)

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the glyph in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

iconMap.description: Incoming value → SF Symbol name ("default" catches the rest)

renderingMode.description: SF rendering mode — multicolor uses the symbol's own colours

palette.description: Hex colour per layer (primary, secondary, tertiary) for palette rendering

variant.description: Symbol variant applied on top of the name

size.description: Explicit point size (default scales to the cell)

effect.description: Native symbol effect or custom rain, snow, sparkle animation

particleColor.description: Custom particle colour (default tint; blue rain, white snow, yellow sparkles in multicolor)

particleIntensity.description: Rain, snow, sparkle density (0 hides particles)

particleAngle.description: Rain/snow direction in degrees from vertical (negative left, positive right)

effectOptions.description: Effect modifiers in Apple's words: iterative, cumulative, reversing, hideInactiveLayers, up, down, clockwise, byLayer, wholeSymbol …

loopCount.description: periodic only — plays before stopping (omit for forever)

activeWhen.description: always | truthy | a state word the synced value must equal

variableMin.description: Numeric value at which the variable layers are empty
